notes.title: Pinball Wicked 1.0
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

The Pinball Wicked release version is live now. 

The Release from Early Access will be tomorrow. 

Thanks for playing Pinball Wicked!


Patch Notes 1.0.8.22

     updated to Unreal Engine 5     
     TSR Temporal Super Resolution to easily reach higher resolutions like 2K/4K or higher framerates
     New music, legacy music will be selectable only if you bought the game during Early Access. This will be available again in a few days.
     Enhanced Low-End Renderer: Significant visual improvements for the low-end renderer, driven by the brand-new iPhone/iPad version
     better AntiAliasing (TAA & TSR)
     better performance
     cabinet - multi screen support always available and yes, offline too    
     game launches now with DirectX 12 per default. The command line option -dx11 allows to explicitly start with DirectX 11     
     for older GPUs and IGPUS: you can launch with the command line option -OverallQuality=2 to directly start in the Performance Quality Level, or -OverallQuality=1 for Performance+
     removed anti-cheat window title check
      fixed: Bonus count in dmd now properly displays if the maximum bonus score is reached. Max bonus score increased to 999,999    

Fixes and improvements during the beta phase

      improved supporter pack glow ball materials for low and medium Material Quality Levels (dependent on Effect Quality setting) to better match the high quality variants and they now emit light on all settings
      improved manual / instruction card
      fixed: fullscreen resolution picker is now visible again
      fixed: spinner coastal reef loop's lights trail the ball again
      fixed: savegame filename is changed so it does not collide with the UE4 version. Due to binary changes of the savegame file format the local highscores will be reset.
      fixed: overall quality graphics presets for medium and high, as well as default settings on first start
      fixed: Medium / High lightmap causing unintended shadows on the playfield
      fixed: when changing RenderQuality to Performance now AntiAliasing is properly set to TAA and TSR settings are blocked as these are not available with this renderer
      fixed: mode specific pure/action overrides in the Operator menu are now saved, and Wickedly Random option works properly now
      fixed: settings - the default button now properly resets all values it's intended to  
      and more fixes and improvements
 

What we're working on now, details to follow soon:

     Leaderboards refresh and upgrade 
     next Table DLCs
     and more
 

Stay tuned! Have Fun! Flip out!

notes.title: Update 7 - Kraken Rising
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29377610/f734313b217ef4c5efd732e30915d70fc5dbaa03.jpg

Ahoy fellow Pinball Lovers!

What's new
A new and colorful UI, the pause screen now displays the main missions' progress and more stats than ever. The Kraken shows it's true tentacles. New and improved portrait cameras and settings. Oh, and you'll be happy to know that the Adventures are now a bit easier to reach. 

Update 7 - Kraken Rising - Patch Notes
 Tentacles! Visible in "Action" mode by default, you can enable these for "Pure" via the "Kraken Mode" options in Settings->Operator.
 new, improved and beautified UI
 Windows desktop display orientation can now be set for the duration of the game via command line arguments (Properties/Set Launch Options...) e.g. 
rotate the main display by 90° / to portrait:  -rotate 90
rotate display 2 by 270° / to portrait (flipped):  -rotate2 270  
 command line options for Player Count 1-4 (-Players 3) and Game Style (-PureAction 0)
 improved cameras: automatic portrait/landscape switch, camera saved per orientation, better handling of aspect ratios for all cameras, orientations and screen sizes, select aspect ratio constraints (16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 3:4).
 dynamic mode for portrait cameras
 camera selection now properly filtered and named according to orientation portrait/landscape
 improved thumbstick/analog plunger control
 seamiles increased by 20% for all lanes/ramps
 Online System to support current and upcoming features
 EULA and Privacy Policy are now presented on the first game start in addition to the already existing confirmation dialog before the game's installation which is presented by the steam client
 feedback: you can now message us directly from within the game, which is especially useful for bug reports as this will transmit some debug information (e.g. ball states). This is currently one way, so if you want a reply please use the other support channels, too.
 fixed: Buccaneer Frenzy achievement
 fix: using Alt+Enter to switch from windowed to fullscreen will now use only valid resolutions as fullscreen resolution 
 fix: the available resolutions are now always properly detected when using multi monitor setups with different diplays



Pinball Cabinet Support Addon
Multi Display / Window Support

The pinball cabinet support addon (beta) is a special offering which you can request directly from us. You can find the request form in the Addons menu of the preview build. This feature does require online activation and is currently available for free. 

A backglass and a dmd window can be configured via the settings menu after activation. Custom background images can be added to the folder %LocalAppData%\PinballWicked\Images


Special Thanks to all of you who have taken the time to check out the preview on the experimental branch! 

Stay tuned! Have fun! Flip out!

notes.title: Update 4 - The Dead Man's ALIVE!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29377610/a7eea32ea667058184771a369764e24237925869.jpg

Ahoy fellow Pinball Lovers!

Thanks for all the great feedback!
 

Performance Update - new Render Quality setting

Up to and including Update 3 we optimized the game to reach >60 fps in hd / 1920x1080 on mid range graphics cards with the highest possible render quality and fully dynamic lighting, thus the recommended hardware requirements. 

In Update 4 we optimized a lot further, targeting a far wider range of GPUs and higher resolutions. The new Render Quality setting offers new high performance graphics feature presets. Changing this setting will take effect the next time you start the game.

Thanks to the Unreal Engine 4's new volumetric light maps even the moving objects keep looking awesome with precomputed lighting. So if you're out for more fps or a higher resolution you should definitely try the new settings!

Render Quality levels

Low (Experimental) is suitable for many integrated GPUs and low end graphics cards, many graphics features are turned off, uses forward rendering and precomputed lighting. This quality level is a work in progress and will change over time.
 
Medium uses mainly precomputed lighting and is suitable for low range graphics cards and mid range integrated GPUs.
 
High mixes precomputed with real time lighting, graphics features are optimized for performance.
 
Epic uses fully dynamic real time lighting for all lights and high end graphics features for the best possible render quality. This matches the only available render quality of Update 3. 


On a GTX 970 / i5 2500K / 1920x1080 changing render quality, leaving the other graphics quality settings on epic, using cam 4: 
Low ~260 fps (limited by cpu), Medium ~160 fps, High ~115-135 fps, Epic ~ 65-80 fps

And for a quick boost on epic settings we added the option to configure Distance Field AO and Screen Space Reflections separately - disabling these nets around 10-25% more fps in epic render quality.


Cabinet users rejoice: Portrait orientation now supported in "Fullscreen" too!

In addition to the screen mode "Windowed Fullscreen", which has worked in portrait orientation since release, you can now also choose full screen portrait resolutions.
 
Enabling portrait mode (vertical screen)
[olist]
     Set the display orientation to "Portrait" in the windows display settings:  RMB on empty desktop -> Display settings -> Orientation: Portrait
     Start the game (optionally: choose a resolution and/or screen mode in Options/Graphics)
     Select camera 6 -> Enjoy ːsteamhappyː
[/olist]

notes.title: The Rules Rule! And a slight ETA shift...
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29377610/9479b6d14234da6485d7f3396e31d6e41fa0b562.jpg

Ahoy fellow Pinball Lovers!

Aaaand... we need a teeny-tiny bit more time, but not to worry we won't change the title to Pinball Wicked Forever. Sorry for the recurring delay - hope 't will be the last :)

Our current ETA is Wednesday, 30 August 2017
 
 
The Black Flaggers Rules Flow Chart

But we won't leave you with nothin' - no, we won't:
We made a nitty-gritty not-so-little flow chart of the Black Flaggers table rules. As with everything Early Access this is a work in progress and might change with time. It currently contains most of the larger, more action heavy modes.

You can find the full size version in the guides section: 
 Black Flaggers Rules Flow Chart 
 
 
Questions from the community

Is this game another mobile port?

It's the other way round -> we don't even have a mobile version yet!
Using the Unreal Engine we're really on the cutting edge of what's possible on the PC.
And while our main focus is the PC version, we'll start to do some real work on the mobile port as soon as we're happy with the state of the Black Flaggers table on the PC. 

What about VR?

VR will be available at a later stage (probably as paid DLC). We can't promise VR support for all upcoming tables yet - it really depends a lot on the demand for this feature.
To achieve the required framerate of 90Hz on the recommended minimal VR hardware we most certainly need to support forward rendering. For this we have to adjust the lighting, which is quite an amount of work - in max quality we currently have more than 300 dynamic lights illuminating the playfield. 

 
We thank you for your continued support!

Stay tuned! Have fun! Flip out!
